task.title: Check a payslip and reply to an employee's salary query
task.brief: An employee says their October salary is lower than it should be. Check the payslip against the attendance and the policy notes below. Then write the email reply to the employee. Take about 20 minutes. A good answer lists each mistake you found, shows the correct amounts, and explains in simple, polite words what went wrong. It should also say how and when the difference will be paid. If something on the payslip is correct, say so briefly.
task.material:
EMPLOYEE EMAIL
From: Kiran Rao (Emp ID 1187)
Hi HR, my October salary credited is Rs 29,827. Normally I get around Rs 31,000. I took only one day off without leave. Please check.

PAYSLIP - OCTOBER 2026 (30-day month) - Kiran Rao
Earnings: Basic 20,000 | HRA 8,000 | Conveyance 1,600 | Special allowance 5,400 | Gross 35,000
Deductions: PF 2,640 | Professional tax 200 | LOP (2 days) 2,333 | Total deductions 5,173
Net pay: 29,827

ATTENDANCE - OCTOBER
Present 27 days, approved casual leave 2 days, absent without leave 1 day.

POLICY NOTES
- PF = 12% of basic pay (Rs 20,000).
- LOP per day = gross / days in month.
- Professional tax in Telangana for this salary = Rs 200.
key_points: PF is wrong: should be Rs 2,400 (12% of 20,000), not Rs 2,640
LOP is wrong: 1 day, about Rs 1,167, not 2 days (Rs 2,333); approved casual leave is not LOP
Correct total deductions about Rs 3,767 and net pay about Rs 31,233
Says when the difference will be paid (e.g. a correction run or next payroll) and that a revised payslip will be shared
Polite tone, thanks the employee and apologises for the error

rubric.label: Correct findings
rubric.guide: 0 = errors missed or wrong maths; 3 = one error found or small maths slip; 5 = both errors found, amounts right

rubric.label: Clear explanation
rubric.guide: 0 = confusing; 3 = right but hard for the employee to follow; 5 = simple, line-by-line, easy to understand

rubric.label: Tone
rubric.guide: 0 = defensive or cold; 3 = polite but stiff; 5 = warm, owns the mistake, reassuring

rubric.label: Next steps
rubric.guide: 0 = no fix promised; 3 = fix mentioned without timing; 5 = clear how and when the difference is paid
